decision_policy.all_outcomes: No further model runs, horizon extension, timestep ladder, coefficient change, or precision change under this protocol.
decision_policy.if_all_24_pass: Report the named-case screen result and stop at 240 s; root may separately assess the already archived h=15 s candidate using archived data, with provenance caveats.
decision_policy.if_any_of_24_fail: Report the earliest failing checkpoint and field plus only its preselected adjacent stage details; do not run new timesteps or change coefficients.

expected_output: One compact JSON/NPZ/CSV analysis bundle with all 24 official rows, 257 internal W trajectory rows, compact all-step Newton/stopping records, verified prefixes, selected detailed stage records, receipts and source hashes.
forbidden_inferences: global state-error bound from local solver defects
project-wide acceptance beyond this named dry case

internal_w_diagnostic.purpose: Compare accepted internal FP64 W endpoints separately from the official NetCDF screen.
reported_metrics: unweighted W RMS/max at all 257 common times
internal_w_diagnostic.time_join: t_j = j*(15/16) s for j=0..256; coarse j matches fine 2j exactly as rational times.

official_screen.comparison: At each exact WRF NetCDF timestamp 60, 120, 180, and 240 s, compare fine-minus-coarse in published FP32 fields promoted to FP64 before differencing/RMS. Apply only the committed V3 field transforms and physical-owner masks; test all 24 (six fields x four timestamps) against the unchanged V3 epsilon/3 reference-check limits.
official_screen.interpretation: Named-case resolution screen only; not truth, an error bound, a convergence-order claim, or project-wide acceptance.

owner_policy.PH: drop fixed lower face; retain top
owner_policy.W: drop fixed lower face; retain dynamic top

official_screen.row_rule: pass iff FP32-NetCDF-promoted-to-FP64 fine-minus-coarse physical-owner RMS <= frozen field epsilon/3

scope: Two continuous 240 s dry em_b_wave ARK3 mode-3 strict-tolerance references on identical source/executable/input/config, h=15/16 and 15/32 s. Offline analysis only after the two authorized runs.

stage_data_retention.all_macrosteps: Retain compact per-step W internal endpoint and global Newton/stopping summary for all 256/512 macrosteps. Retain no full stage arrays except selected diagnostic details.
stage_data_retention.full_stage_details: First accepted macrostep in each run plus the earliest checkpoint-ending macrostep interval associated with any failed V3 row; if all 24 rows pass, use fixed final interval: coarse step 256 and fine steps 511/512.
stage_data_retention.raw_capture_policy: Temporary observer CSVs may be compacted after source/receipt/hash validation; preserve only selected full-step details and compact all-step summaries/endpoint W arrays.
stage_data_retention.selection: If any of 24 V3 rows fails, select the earliest failing checkpoint and its one coarse/two fine macrostep interval. If all pass, select [239.0625,240] s.
stage_data_retention.actual_capture: Reuse unmodified stage_operand_diag existing native writer; all per-step CSVs are TEMPORARY scratch. Do not add a C++/Fortran option, formula, ABI or rebuild.
stage_data_retention.primary_compactor: GreenMetric E-only analyzer reads original CSVs and emits W endpoints, full-six-state prefix/endpoint digests, all-step scalar solver/stopping records and all24 published-field rows.
stage_data_retention.independent_validator: Red independent analysis reads the original temporary CSVs before deletion and independently computes all24 endpoint rows and compact W/solver metrics.
stage_data_retention.deletion_gate: Root authorizes removal of nonselected raw CSVs only after completed process/acceptance/carry/hash gates, agreement of independent compact analyses, and retained-detail SHA verification. Keep per-file original SHA/size and a deletion manifest; discarded full stage arrays are NOT claimed to be losslessly preserved.
stage_data_retention.full_csv_selection: Keep coarse1, fine1 and one coarse/two fine interval ending at earliest failed OFFICIAL checkpoint; if all24 pass retain coarse256,fine511,fine512. Additional anomaly details only if an actual failure prevents completion; do not add runs.

status_note: This is a paired refinement screen; the h=15 s candidate is a separate archived comparison handled outside this two-run reference protocol.

strict_60s_prefix_reuse.reuse: No additional 60 s run. Compare PR310 packed six-state input and projected endpoint at 60 s against the corresponding E309 strict-tolerance pair states, and verify those source receipts/source/executable/input hashes.

conditional_archived_candidate.candidate: PR304 original-e71 h15/240s post-CF archive or PR306 bitwise-identical h15 bridge; no new candidate run
conditional_archived_candidate.reference: the newly computed fine h=15/32s strict-Newton trajectory, fixed in advance
conditional_archived_candidate.criterion: candidate-minus-qualified-fine RMS <= original full epsilon_X at each of four named timestamps (NOT epsilon_X/3, which is the reference sensitivity rule)
